slides.title: Why did Horn of Africa diaspora groups rally at the US State Department?

slides.text: Addis Standard reports a **coalition of diaspora communities** gathered outside the **US State Department** in Washington on **Nov 16**.
Participants included **Afar, Amhara, Oromo, Tigrayan and Somali** communities, plus Eritrean and Sudanese groups, calling for an **end to hostilities**.
They urged **independent investigations** and **accountability**. No response from the **Ethiopian government** or the **State Department** was reported.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Nov 17, 2026
